instruction: Use 05_FINAL_DICT_4COL and 06_MAJOR_GATES to audit every existing cluster annotation against cluster marker tables (Top20/Top50/Top100).
For each cluster, use current major label, current subtype label, Top20/Top50/Top100 markers, number of cells, number of patients/samples, and any existing QC/doublet flags.
First test whether the cluster fits its current major lineage using 06_MAJOR_GATES. If strong markers from another lineage dominate, set decision = REASSIGN_MAJOR.
Within the accepted major lineage, compare against every subtype in 05_FINAL_DICT_4COL. Prioritize coherent multi-gene programs over a single gene.

Optional audit score: +3 per defining marker in Top20, +2 in Top50, +1 in Top100; -3/-2/-1 for exclusion markers in Top20/50/100. Treat this only as a ranking heuristic, not a biological/statistical test.

Prefer >=2 defining markers, including at least one relatively subtype-specific marker. A single marker should not be sufficient unless it is highly specific and the rest of the program is concordant.
If >=2 strong exclusion markers from an incompatible lineage appear in Top20/Top50, mark CONFLICT and inspect for doublet, ambient RNA, or incorrect major assignment.

For TET_TEC / TC_Carc_TEC_1 / TC_Carc_TEC_2 / CDH3_malignant, first require a convincing epithelial program. Use CNV/aneuploidy evidence when available; do not call malignancy from one tumor-associated marker alone.
NKG7/GNLY/PRF1 alone do not distinguish NK from cytotoxic T. Use CD3D/E/TRBC to distinguish pure NK from T/NKT.
High immunoglobulin transcripts alone can reflect ambient RNA. Require MZB1/XBP1/JCHAIN or a coherent ASC/plasmablast program.
Do not merge pDC/cDC1/cDC2/migDC simply because all express HLA genes. Use LILRA4/JCHAIN (pDC), CLEC9A (cDC1), CD1C/FCER1A/CLEC10A (cDC2), LAMP3/CCR7/FSCN1 (migDC).
Avoid forcing M1/M2 labels from one or two genes. Prefer Macrophage_C1QC / Macrophage_NLRP3, and use M2 only as an optional state description when supported by broader evidence.
TET-associated ECM fibroblasts should show TWIST1/ITGA11/SDC1 with ECM genes such as CTHRC1/LRRC15/COL11A1/MMP11; distinguish from RGS5/PDGFRB mural cells.
Downgrade confidence if a proposed subtype is driven almost entirely by one sample/patient, unless the subtype is known to be rare or pathology-specific.

KEEP = current annotation strongly supported; RENAME = same major, better subtype name; REASSIGN_MAJOR = wrong major lineage; EXCLUDE = doublet/low-quality/contaminated; UNCERTAIN = insufficient or conflicting evidence.
major_original; subtype_original; major_recommended; subtype_recommended; decision; defining_hits; exclusion_hits; confidence; reason; uncertainty; dominant_sample_fraction; suggested_action
Use the exact subtype names from 05_FINAL_DICT_4COL. Do not invent new names unless no listed subtype fits; in that case keep a conservative descriptive label and mark UNCERTAIN.

Absence of a marker in scRNA-seq is weak negative evidence because of dropout. Exclusion markers are most useful when they are positively and strongly expressed, not merely when defining markers are absent.

Defining markers are condensed from the five uploaded thymoma/TET papers. Exclusion markers are audit-oriented cross-lineage negatives derived from the same papers' major-lineage marker programs; they are not claimed to be literal exclusion lists published by the authors.
This dictionary intentionally merges many paper-specific microstates to improve reproducibility across datasets. The original, more granular marker table remains in 02_SUBTYPE_MARKERS.
